dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what are you going to do after you graduate?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈduː ˈæftər juː ˈɡrædʒueɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope to get a job in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp tə ˈɡɛt ə ˈdʒɑːb ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I want to become a teacher, like my parents. I love English!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə bɪˈkʌm ə ˈtiːtʃər, laɪk maɪ ˈpɛrənts. aɪ ˈlʌv ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But before I become a teacher, I'm going to travel abroad.
dialogue.reading: bʌt bɪˈfɔːr aɪ bɪˈkʌm ə ˈtiːtʃər, aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtrævəl əˈbrɔːd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: When I have money, I'll go to Canada with Emma!
dialogue.reading: wɛn aɪ ˈhæv ˈmʌni, aɪl ˈɡoʊ tə ˈkænədə wɪð ˈɛmə!
